news: Launch pack: every region and side activity Rockstar has confirmed. Story missions, collectibles, vehicles and trophies are added here as players find them after launch on Nov 19. No app update needed.

categories.name: Explore Leonida
categories.note: The six regions Rockstar has shown, plus named spots in Vice City.

items.name: Reach Vice City
items.detail: The neon, beach-and-nightlife heart of Leonida.

items.name: Island-hop the Leonida Keys
items.detail: Bridges, bars and turquoise water south of the city.

items.name: Head into the Grassrivers
items.detail: Swampy wetlands with mangroves and gators.

items.name: Visit Port Gellhorn
items.detail: A run-down old vacation coast with cheap motels.

items.name: Explore Mount Kalaga National Park
items.detail: Wild parkland up on the northern border.

items.name: Eat your way through Little Cuba
items.detail: One of Vice City's named neighborhoods.

items.name: Check out the Vice City port
Spot a sea turtle
items.detail: Keep an eye on the water around the Keys.

items.name: Spot an alligator
items.detail: The Grassrivers are full of them. Keep your distance.
